body:
I pause for a moment, taking deep breaths as I try to calm down. Realizing that my anger isn't productive, I focus on observing what has caused this issue. I notice the choir members are asleep when the light should be on, suggesting they may not see it as a problem themselves. 

Thinking about this, I decide the best approach would be to gently bring attention back to reality without being confrontational. So, quietly approaching them later during practice time, I speak softly but clearly:

"Guys, can we talk about our evening routines? Maybe there's something I'm missing out on because I've been so focused on this?"

This methodical approach allows me to address the issue calmly while respecting everyone's personal space and comfort levels.
full:
I pause for a moment, taking deep breaths as I try to calm down. Realizing that my anger isn't productive, I focus on observing what has caused this issue. I notice the choir members are asleep when the light should be on, suggesting they may not see it as a problem themselves. 

Thinking about this, I decide the best approach would be to gently bring attention back to reality without being confrontational. So, quietly approaching them later during practice time, I speak softly but clearly:

"Guys, can we talk about our evening routines? Maybe there's something I'm missing out on because I've been so focused on this?"

This methodical approach allows me to address the issue calmly while respecting everyone's personal space and comfort levels. Next: confront the person responsible directly.
